nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 业务需要与具体制作项目
nodes.message:
Hi,

Could your team reach its next asset milestone with less repetitive modeling and fewer file handoffs?

Tripo generates a 3D starting model from text or images. In the treasure-chest example, artists develop the generated base into material variants and finish it for a game.

Tripo Studio Team Plan adds shared credits, member access and a searchable asset library to support your own team's creation and reuse.

Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

下一阶段资产交付，团队能否少一些重复建模与文件交接？

Tripo 可从文字或图片生成3D初始模型。在宝箱制作示例中，美术成员基于生成模型制作不同材质版本，并完成游戏使用所需的处理。

Tripo Studio 团队版则提供共享积分、成员权限和可搜索的资产库，支持你自己的团队开展制作与复用。

留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 实际制作环节与团队复用
nodes.message:
The treasure-chest example starts with Tripo generation, Mesh Edit, Smart UV and PBR textures. Artists make material variants in Substance Painter and set the pivot and LODs, add collision, and build the opening interaction in Blender/Unreal.

The character walkthrough shows generation, mesh repair, UV/texture work and rigging, followed by artist assembly and Unreal checks.

For your team, evaluate these production steps alongside Team Plan's shared credits and asset library. Explore either walkthrough, or discuss your asset needs with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
宝箱示例从 Tripo 生成、Mesh Edit、Smart UV 和 PBR 贴图开始。美术成员在 Substance Painter 中制作不同材质版本，并在 Blender／Unreal 中完成轴心、LOD、碰撞和开箱交互等处理。

角色流程展示生成、模型修复、UV／贴图处理与绑定，再由美术完成组装及 Unreal 检查。

为你自己的团队评估时，可将这些制作环节与团队版的共享积分、资产库一起考虑。你可以查看任一完整制作流程，或与 Tripo 沟通资产需求。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 统计完整制作投入
nodes.message:
Choose a small set of real characters and props; 10 assets is one option, not a requirement. Compare your current process with generation, retries, artist cleanup, review and in-game checks.

Record credits, artist hours, final acceptance and reuse, including the work needed after generation. This is how to judge cost and delivery fit for your team.

Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options.
nodes.messageZh:
先选一小组真实角色与道具；10项资产是可选样本量，不是要求。对照现有流程，评估生成、重试、美术精修、审核及游戏内检查。

记录积分、美术工时、最终验收和复用情况，也要计入生成后的处理。这些信息才有助于判断团队的成本与交付适配性。

留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.messageZh:
你好，

下一版游戏需要的是可继续制作的道具与角色，而不只是一张3D预览，对吗？

Tripo 的游戏制作示例展示了两种具体用途：宝箱经过处理，形成不同材质版本并实现开箱交互；风格化角色经美术精修后，在 Unreal 中展示动画。

Tripo Studio 团队版则提供共享积分、成员权限和可搜索的资产库，服务于你自己的团队制作。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 宝箱与角色的具体游戏用途
nodes.message:
One example becomes an interactive treasure chest: generated base, local edits and material variants, then artist-built pivot, LOD, collision and opening behavior in Blender/Unreal.

Another becomes an animated character: separate head/body generation, mesh and texture refinement, rig preview, artist assembly and final animation in Unreal.

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Want 3D generation in your game-asset tools without building the underlying model yourself?

Tripo API accepts text or images and returns 3D models through asynchronous tasks: submit, check status and retrieve the result. Your team builds the integration and reviews assets for the game.

See how the requests work, or review what to measure before implementation. Open Quick Start when your team is ready to try the API.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

想为游戏资产工具接入3D生成，而不必自己从零搭建底层模型？

Tripo API 支持提交文字或图片，通过异步任务生成3D模型：提交任务、查询状态，再取回结果。系统接入及游戏资产审核仍由你的团队完成。

先了解请求流程，或查看实施前应评估哪些投入。团队准备尝试 API 时，可打开 Quick Start。

buttons.label: See the API workflow
buttons.labelZh: 查看 API 接入流程

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 异步任务如何接入工具
nodes.message:
Your tool submits text or images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task.

Your team implements the interface and integration, then reviews geometry, materials and target-engine performance. Tripo supplies the generation layer, not a finished game integration.

Open Quick Start to review the request flow and prepare your integration.
nodes.messageZh:
你的工具提交文字或图片并取得任务 ID，随后查询状态，在任务成功后取回模型。

交互界面及系统接入由你的团队开发，再由团队检查几何、材质和目标引擎中的性能。Tripo 提供生成层，而不是已经完成接入的游戏功能。

打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程并准备接入。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 评估接入与制作总投入
nodes.message:
For a focused evaluation, choose 10 real game assets covering common and difficult cases. Define acceptance criteria, then record time to first approved output, retries, cleanup, engine-review time and API cost.

Include integration work when comparing the total effort with your current process.

Use Quick Start to prepare a test your team can run.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围评估时，可选10项真实游戏资产，覆盖常见需求和难处理的情况。先确定验收标准，再记录首个验收通过输出所需时间、重试、精修、引擎检查时间和 API 费用。

对比现有流程的总投入时，也计入系统接入所需的开发工作。

通过 Quick Start 准备由你的团队实际执行测试。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Bring text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation into the tools your game team already uses.

Tripo API accepts text or images and returns 3D models through asynchronous tasks: submit, check status and retrieve the result. Your team builds the integration and reviews assets for the game.

See how the requests work, or review what to measure before implementation. Open Quick Start when your team is ready to try the API.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

把文字和图片生成3D模型的能力，接入游戏团队已经在用的工具。

Tripo API 支持提交文字或图片，通过异步任务生成3D模型：提交任务、查询状态，再取回结果。系统接入及游戏资产审核仍由你的团队完成。

先了解请求流程，或查看实施前应评估哪些投入。团队准备尝试 API 时，可打开 Quick Start。

buttons.label: See the API workflow
buttons.labelZh: 查看 API 接入流程

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 异步任务如何接入工具
nodes.message:
Your tool submits text or images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task.

Your team implements the interface and integration, then reviews geometry, materials and target-engine performance. Tripo supplies the generation layer, not a finished game integration.

Open Quick Start to review the request flow and prepare your integration.
nodes.messageZh:
你的工具提交文字或图片并取得任务 ID，随后查询状态，在任务成功后取回模型。

交互界面及系统接入由你的团队开发，再由团队检查几何、材质和目标引擎中的性能。Tripo 提供生成层，而不是已经完成接入的游戏功能。

打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程并准备接入。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 评估接入与制作总投入
nodes.message:
For a focused evaluation, choose 10 real game assets covering common and difficult cases. Define acceptance criteria, then record time to first approved output, retries, cleanup, engine-review time and API cost.

Include integration work when comparing the total effort with your current process.

Use Quick Start to prepare a test your team can run.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围评估时，可选10项真实游戏资产，覆盖常见需求和难处理的情况。先确定验收标准，再记录首个验收通过输出所需时间、重试、精修、引擎检查时间和 API 费用。

对比现有流程的总投入时，也计入系统接入所需的开发工作。

通过 Quick Start 准备由你的团队实际执行测试。

variants.subjectZh: 接入3D产品内容，不必自研底层模型

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Looking to add 3D product content to your platform without building a generation model in-house?

Tripo API generates 3D assets from product images, so your team can use an existing generation layer rather than develop its own model. Submit a task, check its status and retrieve the result for review and use in your platform.

See the path from an image to a reviewed display asset, or check what to assess first. Open Quick Start to prepare the integration.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

想为平台加入3D产品内容，而不必内部自研底层生成模型？

Tripo API 可从产品图片生成3D资产，让团队使用现成的生成层，而不必自研底层模型。提交任务、查询状态，再取回结果，经审核后接入自己的平台。

先了解从图片到经审核展示资产的流程，或查看应先评估哪些要求。打开 Quick Start，准备系统接入。

buttons.label: See product workflow
buttons.labelZh: 查看产品展示接入流程

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 从图片到产品展示
nodes.message:
Your platform submits product images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task.

Check shape, dimensions and materials against the real product; correct or reject unsuitable outputs before display. Your team builds the viewer, integration and publishing workflow.

Open Quick Start to review the request flow and prepare your integration.
nodes.messageZh:
平台提交产品图片并取得任务 ID，随后查询状态，在任务成功后取回模型。

对照实物核对外观、尺寸和材质，在展示前修正或弃用不合适的输出。查看器、系统接入及发布流程由你的团队开发。

打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程并准备接入。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 评估产品还原与接入投入
nodes.message:
For a focused evaluation, choose 10 real products covering common and difficult shapes or materials. Set display requirements and compare outputs with the actual products.

Record accepted assets, retries, correction time and API cost. Include viewer and integration work when comparing the total effort with your current content process.

Use Quick Start to prepare a test your team can run.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围评估时，可选10款真实产品，覆盖常见及难处理的外形或材质。先设定展示要求，再对照实物检查输出。

记录通过验收的资产、重试、人工修正时间及 API 费用。对比现有内容流程的总投入时，也计入查看器与系统接入的开发工作。

通过 Quick Start 准备由你的团队实际执行测试。
